name: 고객 기본 정보
sql: SELECT join_date, age_band FROM app.customer_profile LIMIT 200

name: 보유 카드 목록
sql: SELECT card_ref, product_name, brand, issue_date, current_status, annual_fee FROM app.customer_cards ORDER BY card_ref LIMIT 200

name: 카드별 월 사용액(최근 6개월)
sql: SELECT card_ref, month, period_start, period_end, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.monthly_usage ORDER BY month, card_ref LIMIT 200

name: 월 사용액 합계(최근 6개월, 전체 카드)
sql: SELECT month, sum(approved_amount)::bigint AS approved_amount, sum(transaction_count)::integer AS transaction_count FROM app.monthly_usage GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

name: 업종별 사용액(최근 6개월)
sql: SELECT category, sum(approved_amount)::bigint AS approved_amount, sum(transaction_count)::integer AS transaction_count FROM app.merchant_usage GROUP BY category ORDER BY approved_amount DESC LIMIT 200

name: 최근 연체 현황
sql: SELECT base_month, as_of_date, overdue_amount, overdue_days, overdue_count_12m FROM app.customer_delinquency LIMIT 200

name: 연체 이력(최근 12개월)
sql: SELECT base_month, as_of_date, overdue_amount, overdue_days, overdue_count_12m FROM app.customer_delinquency_history ORDER BY base_month LIMIT 200

name: 일별 사용액(최근 90일)
sql: SELECT usage_date, approved_amount, transaction_count FROM app.customer_daily_usage ORDER BY usage_date LIMIT 200
